tasks.title: Implement Acknowledgment & Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)
tasks.description: Wrap worker stream consumption in try/catch blocks with XACK upon success and forward poisoned pills to an isolated DLQ stream.
tasks.deliverable: worker.ts supporting retry counts and DLQ forwarding.
tasks.starterSnippet: export async function processTaskWithRetry(job: any, client: any) { try { await handleJob(job); await client.xack('queue_stream', 'workers', job.id); } catch(err) { await client.xadd('dlq_stream', '*', 'payload', JSON.stringify(job)); } }

tasks.title: Distributed Rate Limiting Middleware
tasks.description: Build an Express/FastAPI middleware enforcing sliding-window rate limits via Redis EVAL scripts.
tasks.deliverable: rateLimiter.ts middleware applied to core API routes.
tasks.starterSnippet: export const rateLimit = (limit: number, windowSec: number) => async (req: any, res: any, next: any) => { const key = `rate:${req.ip}`; const current = await redis.incr(key); if (current === 1) await redis.expire(key, windowSec); if (current > limit) return res.status(429).json({ error: 'Too many requests' }); next(); };

tasks.title: Write Multi-Stage Dockerfile with Non-Root Security
tasks.description: Implement multi-stage Alpine build with security scanner passing zero CVEs.
tasks.starterSnippet:
FROM python:3.12-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --prefix=/install -r requirements.txt

FROM python:3.12-alpine
WORKDIR /app
RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup
COPY --from=builder /install /usr/local
COPY . .
USER appuser
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
